scope: Real mouse/keyboard input, rendered feedback, and a full Minecraft process restart; setup/chat queries are labeled separately from gameplay input

cases.input: Use the held token with a real right mouse click in a newly created local test world
cases.expect: Visible active, inactive, then active feedback from successive permitted clicks; leave a nondefault active token for the save/restart test

cases.input: Place two stones with actual BlockItem right clicks; increment their counts separately
cases.expect: Visible feedback and independent world block counts, targeting A=3 and B=7; record exact world positions

cases.input: Perform actual sneak-right-click on one nonzero stone
cases.expect: Stone A visibly resets to zero; stone B remains at the recorded nonzero count 7

cases.input: As the fixed survival player, break mature wheat with a real left mouse click; invoke the read-only ledger command
cases.expect: A successful mature break increases the displayed total from zero to one for the fixed player; retain this nonzero total for restart

cases.input: Use Save and Quit, then Quit Game; wait for the public product task to finish; start a new product run-client task and rejoin the same world
cases.expect: Old process exits normally, a new process/task joins the same world as the same player, stone B restores 7, the token restores active state, and the ledger restores its recorded nonzero total

evidenceRequired: Input type, target and timestamp from actual desktop tool calls
Screenshots of the actual feedback and read-only in-game state queries
Current-run client logs and product JSONL task boundaries
World path and fixed player identity before/after restart
Before/after verified JAR set and hashes
excludedClaims: A title screen or render-ready log is not a client behavior pass
Server mock/codec tests are not full client restart proof
Artwork, audio quality and fun remain subjective judgments
